name: Cleared authentication state cannot reopen a protected route
description:
Objective: Cleared authentication state cannot reopen a protected route.
Preconditions: Open Login and session with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Login and session.
2. Cleared authentication state cannot reopen a protected route.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: A client-side session clear must not leave protected data accessible.
